verdict.rationale: The DGX B200 ships management software (health-check CLI, BMC with Redfish, IPMI and a web UI, and Mission Control), so natural-language operation is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence shows the product accepting natural-language commands. The documented interfaces are conventional command-line and protocol-based, and the llms.txt documentation files are reference material for AI agents, not a natural-language control interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
